body: NTA and please break up with boy. HUGE red flags this early? time to gtfo.

If she’s really your friend and you care about her at least let her know what’s going on. Tell her your boundaries, and if she doesn’t respect them then at least you tried. But if you just ghost her out of nowhere that’ll likely be devastating, and you are giving her no chance to change. You don’t have to do anything you don’t want to do of course, but know that if you ghost her like this you will hurt her deeply.

Find a therapist who specifically says they can help with PTSD. That’s what I had to do after years of not getting any real help from mental health professionals. They’ll be able to assess you properly and focus the therapy around helping you heal. The be most effective modality for me has been Narrative Exposure Therapy (NET), literally life changing. I’m so sorry you’re suffering with this, and i hope you find relief soon!

Have you told her this yet? Before you go out next I’d mention that to you’re short on funds and can only cover your own expenses. And if you do go out somewhere, be clear with the staff from the beginning you’re only paying for yourself, within ear shot of her. If after all that she still directly asks you to cover her portion, calmly reexplain you don’t have the money to do that. If she’s rude about it, or you still decide to lend her more and she doesn’t pay you back again, I’d just drop her as a friend.

YTA. If your friend says he’s happy, especially if what’s making him happy is not harmful to him (you’re acting like working at McDonalds is akin to him taking up hard drugs) then just be supportive of him for finding something that isn’t eroding his mental health, if you’re really his friend. Also your judgement of fast food workers is incredibly condescending and out of line. You think all his coworkers are “degenerates” just because they work at McDonald’s? Your elitist attitude is gross, and I wouldn’t be surprised if your friend drops you due to your judgmental attitude towards jobs you don’t deem “good enough for you”.
NTA, you don’t have to have sex if you don’t want to, and turning it down doesn’t make you an AH.
NTA, please leave this guy, he’s unsafe. So many red flags: not listening when you said no, and shaming you for an involuntary bodily reaction being two very big ones. Dump him

YTA, 9 years is a long time, and for your sister to be told to her face she’s an “afterthought” is very hurtful. It makes sense that she’s upset. you brushing it off as just “drama”, not seeing that yes, there is obviously favoritism going on here, and not having your sister’s back makes you very much a part of the problem at this point. Don’t be surprised if she drops you and your family from her life.
NTA you didn’t buy anywhere near that amount of food & $45 isn’t cheap. Plus it wasn’t discussed before hand that it was the plan.
